title: Returnless Refund Limits and Damage Report Deadlines — Northgate Purchases & Returns
content:
Some Northgate Purchases & Returns channels allow a refund without the merchandise coming back. This limits table gives, for each channel, the reasons that qualify, the largest line refund allowed that way, the deadline for reporting damaged, missing-part or not-received merchandise, and how many not-received or damaged-in-transit returnless refunds member services may grant one membership in a rolling 365 days.

| Channel | Reasons qualifying for a returnless refund | Highest line refund without return (USD) | Report deadline (calendar days after the fulfillment date) | Not-received or damaged-in-transit returnless refunds per membership in a rolling 365 days |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Northgate In-Club Purchase | none | 0.00 (never) | 0 | 0 |
| Northgate Club Pickup Order | none | 0.00 (never) | 1 | 0 |
| Northgate Same-Day Delivery Order | none | 0.00 (never) | 2 | 0 |
| Northgate.com Ship-to-Home Order | damaged in transit; not received | 25.00 | 30 | 2 |
| Northgate Business Delivery Order | damaged in transit; not received; missing parts | 100.00 | 2 | 4 |
| Northgate Special Order | none | 0.00 (never) | 3 | 0 |

## Limits explained

- A maximum of 0.00 means the channel never refunds without return. Only the Northgate.com Ship-to-Home Order (up to 25.00 per line) and the Northgate Business Delivery Order (up to 100.00 per line) do.
- A missing-parts report qualifies for a returnless refund only on the Northgate Business Delivery Order.
- The report deadline exists on every channel except the Northgate In-Club Purchase, where it is 0.

| Hypothetical case | Channel | Line amount | Reason | Within the limit table |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| A | Northgate.com Ship-to-Home Order | 25.00 | not received | yes, equal to the 25.00 maximum |
| B | Northgate.com Ship-to-Home Order | 25.01 | not received | no, above the maximum |
| C | Northgate Business Delivery Order | 60.00 | missing parts | yes |
| D | Northgate.com Ship-to-Home Order | 10.00 | missing parts | no, reason not listed |
